objective: Rellian Greenspyre wants you to speak with Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.

description: I have just received word that  Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.
Make haste, <name>; he needs our help.
completion: Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. I am glad you arrived here so soon.
I have discovered something quite disturbing!
